name: Loop of 2 hours from Hörby, west, around towns
description: From a real test (2026-09-26): heading west, the third loop left the country roads for Lund, rode 5 km of its 30–40 km/h streets to a waypoint in town and came back out. City riding is dull; a loop should ride around a town unless going through leads to better roads. Town street corners had counted as curves, and waypoints could land on town streets. Riding through a village on its main road stays fine (up to 5 km of 40 km/h streets per loop here; the Lund loop had 6).
